🌟 trail-mate | C++
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enabling reliable communication, navigation, and team situational awareness in off-grid or no-network environments, prioritizing user control and data sovereignty.
✨ Key Features: • Offline-first operation • Decentralized communication (Meshtastic, MeshCore, Reticulum) • Anonymous operation • On-device TAK capability for situational awareness • User-controlled identity and data storage
📖 Summary: Trail Mate is a decentralized, offline-first system for secure communication and situational awareness in environments without network access. It prioritizes user control over identity, data, and connectivity, running on personal devices for navigation, team coordination, and data management.
